pages.title: Ajman
pages.description: one of the seven emirates of the United Arab Emirates
pages.extract: Ajman (Arabic: عجمان 'Aǧmān; Gulf Arabic: عيمان ʿYmān) is the fifth-largest and fifth-most populous city in the United Arab Emirates, after Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and Al Ain. It is the capital of the Emirate of Ajman and forms part of a part of the metropolitan sprawl of greater Dubai. It is bounded by the Persian Gulf to the west and surrounded by the Emirate of Sharjah on land.

pages.title: Amsterdam/Oost
pages.extract: Oost (Dutch for East) is a borough of Amsterdam. It lies between the Amstel River in the west and the IJ in the east. It should not be regarded as a homogeneous area, as there are many different neighbourhoods with their own cultures and identities. The main area is around the Oosterpark. The Eastern Docklands and IJburg are also lively upper middle class areas and their modern architecture shows a completely different side of Amsterdam.

pages.title: Bankura
pages.extract: Bankura (Bengali: বাঁকুড়া Bānkuṛā) is the headquarters of its namesake Bankura district of West Bengal. Bankura town is an important stopover for most of the tourist destinations in the district.

pages.title: Bayanhongor
pages.extract: Bayanhongor is the capital of Bayanhongor province. Outside of the city are many hot springs, rivers, lakes, oases, and the Great Gobi A National Park.

pages.title: Franklin Park
pages.description: village in Cook County, Illinois, United States
pages.extract: Franklin Park is a village in the Chicagoland area, near O'Hare International Airport.  Incorporated in 1892, the town is steeped in train culture; it's served by three Metra stations, has a large train yard, and celebrates its history with a train museum and festival.  In addition, there is a burgeoning suburban downtown, a large Hispanic population (which means great food), and many community gathering places.

pages.title: Kapparis
pages.extract: Kapparis is a village close to Paralimni on the coast of Cyprus. The beaches, some of the best in the country, consist mainly of small beautiful bays each offering something different.

pages.title: Lomé
pages.extract: Lomé is the capital and largest city of Togo. With a population of almost 2.2 million (2023), the city is the economic and cultural center of the country. Around a quarter of the country's population lives here.

pages.title: Mangamuka Bridge
pages.description: locality in Far North District, Northland Region, New Zealand

pages.title: Natitingou
pages.description: city and commune in north western Benin
pages.extract: Natitingou is a town in Northern Benin.

pages.title: Osoyoos
pages.extract: Osoyoos (IPA: /ɒˈsɔjuːs/) (pronounced "O-sew-use"), is a town in the southern Okanagan valley of British Columbia that is a popular summer holiday destination. The town has about 5100 permanent residents (2016).

pages.title: Richmond Hill (Ontario)
pages.extract: Richmond Hill is a city in Southern Ontario in the central portion of York Region. It's part of the Greater Toronto Area, about 20 km north of the downtown core of Toronto.

pages.title: Tolmin
pages.extract: Tolmin is a city in Slovenia.

pages.title: Woods Hole
pages.description: census-designated place in town of Falmouth, Barnstable County, Massachusetts, United States
pages.extract: The village of Woods Hole administratively belongs to the town of Falmouth, in the Upper Cape area of Cape Cod, Massachusetts. Woods Hole has a great natural harbor and was once a fishing and whaling center but now is known for its beautiful beaches, sport fishing, quaint shops (no chain stores here) and marine research facilities.

pages.title: Northwich
pages.description: town and civil parish in Cheshire West and Chester, England, UK
pages.extract: Northwich is a market and port town  of 50,000 people (2021) in Cheshire.

pages.title: Khiamniungan Naga phrasebook
pages.description: Major Naga language, sino-Tibetan language spoken in India, Noklak district Nagaland
pages.extract: Patsho Khiamniungan or colloquially Patsho Nyu is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken by the Khiamniungans in North Eastern parts of India in the state of Nagaland, Noklak district. It also refers to the people living in the district mostly inhabiting the western part, that of Patsho range, southern part i.e. Thuonoknyu administrative circle and sparingly all over Noklak. Above all, it is a village with one of the highest number of Population in the region. Sometimes, it refers to Patsho speaking group of people who are native to and belong to Patsho Village. The language is widely known who are native to Noklak district and parts of Myanmar.

pages.title: Snoqualmie
pages.description: city in King County, Washington, United States of America
pages.extract: Snoqualmie is a city in King County of Washington state, just above the scenic Snoqualmie Falls. Moreso than other cities in the region, it has preserved ties to its varied past, as a Native American community, a logging company town and a busy rail depot along one of the region's first railways.
